_about: RunPod pod template (console: Templates > New Template, paste these fields). The pod's own https proxy serves port 8189, so no tunnel is needed. Billing runs while the pod runs; the worker stops the pod after FZ_IDLE_MINUTES idle or FZ_MAX_HOURS.
name: fendezy-creative-worker
vast_onstart: git clone -q --depth 1 -b build/creative-selfhost https://github.com/thedonnasystem/JARVIS /root/fz && python3 /root/fz/creative_studio/selfhost/worker/fz_worker.py --profile 24gb --tunnel cloudflared --root /root/fzw --idle-minutes 20 --max-hours 3
